dataset_name: Alibaton Performance & Development - Canonical Performance Goal Plans and Governed Progress Baseline V2
authority: Defense-ready Performance planning baseline derived from the canonical workforce reference for personnel identity, department, position, person type, and reporting context. Numeric goal progress is a controlled Performance baseline and is not copied from workforce profile data or LMS records.

boundary_rules.formal_progress_authority: Formal Goal/KPI progress and status are verified and maintained by the assigned evaluator/direct supervisor for the active Performance cycle.
boundary_rules.employee_evidence: Employees may provide goal-progress evidence through enabled self-evaluation or documented check-in workflows; employee-submitted evidence never directly changes the formal percentage.
boundary_rules.admin_hr_governance: Admin/HR monitor coverage and governance. Administrative corrections require a reason, are explicitly marked as corrections, and are audited.
boundary_rules.weight_governance: Published or assigned plan weights are locked for the cycle. Material weighting changes require a revised/new plan or a future cycle.
boundary_rules.lms_boundary: LMS completion, Pre-Test/Post-Test scores, certificates, and course progress never calculate Performance goal progress or a Performance rating.
boundary_rules.workforce_reference_role: The workforce reference determines canonical people, department, position, manager, person type, and career context. It does not directly provide Performance goal percentages.
